title: Craft Web Editors config
description: Plugin config persisted under plugins['craft-web'].* in ~/.pi/dashboard/config.json. The plugin is OPT-IN (manifest defaultEnabled:false). Per-app switches are enforced server-side too: prepare and saves are refused for a disabled app. Read live (no restart) by status, prepare and the file-validator enabled() switch.

apps.description: Per-app switches. An app without a verified web build version contributes no handler regardless of this flag.

enabled.description: When false the app's mode shows as disabled, prepare is refused (403) and saves through its claim are refused (403).

version.description: Version channel. 'pinned' uses the verified web build. 'latest' tracks the newest release that publishes a web build (checked at most once a day); a newer one shows as a Download (update) action, and a failed update keeps the prepared build. Latest builds are not verified against the host shim. Env <APP>_WEB_VERSION overrides this.
